monetary_rule.basis: UI divides raw API monetary values by1e6 for triệu đồng or1e9 for tỷ đồng; not inferred from magnitude or matching PDF numbers
monetary_rule.scope: Only exact route+reviewed monetary code/label+non-static template; other templates/financial sectors need independent proof

exceptions: KQKD EPS/ratio/static rows use special formatter, not monetary divisor. Keep VND/share or unknown until exact branch/template verified.
Provider UI FindData may replace missing with0 and hide0 as dash; collector must preserve original JSON missing/null/zero separately.
Unit proof is independent from field placement accuracy; BRC/VNM row displacement remains quarantined.
Raw units do not prove scope, currency conversion, report vintages, publication, fiscal duration or original-maturity debt.
